name: Casalmaggiore (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casalmaggiore (a yellow castle gate on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Casalmaggiore, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 17 October 1932.

features.role: Casalmaggiore arms — castle gate on blue, crowned, within branches
